metadata.description: A curated collection of Claude Code mods. Shared as-is.

plugins.name: auto-checkpoint
plugins.description: Snapshots the working tree into hidden git refs at the start of every turn, with /checkpoints to list them and /undo-turn to roll back.

plugins.name: branch-guard
plugins.description: Stops Claude from editing files or running mutating git commands on main or master, and points it at a worktree instead.

plugins.name: cost-bar
plugins.description: A one-row band above the prompt with session cost, 5h/7d plan limits and an optional budget bar.

plugins.name: file-tree-pane
plugins.description: Adds /tree: a side pane with a lazy file tree coloured by git status. Press a file to put @path in the prompt.

plugins.name: notify-on-finish
plugins.description: Sends a desktop notification when a long turn finishes, so you can look away while Claude works.

plugins.name: path-guard
plugins.description: Blocks Write, Edit and MultiEdit calls that target a path outside the project root or inside .git, plus optional deny globs.

plugins.name: powerline-bar
plugins.description: A one-row powerline-style band above the prompt: directory, git branch and state, model, context fill.

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Blocks Write, Edit and Bash calls that would put an API key, token or private key into a file or command.

plugins.name: sensitive-file-guard
plugins.description: Blocks Read, Write, Edit, Grep, Glob and Bash calls that touch .env files, private keys and credential stores.

plugins.name: spinner-stats
plugins.description: Adds elapsed time, the running tool and the tool-call count to Claude Code's own spinner.

plugins.name: test-guard
plugins.description: Blocks edits that make tests pass by weakening them: new skip/only markers, fewer assertions, a gutted test file, or deleting a test file.
